references.text: Confirms the promise that the armed men will cross over Jordan before the Lord until the war is over
Reiterates the commitment to go armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan
Moses reminds the tribes of their vow to go armed before their brothers until the land is taken
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh that their wives, children, and livestock must remain in the cities east of Jordan
Fulfillment of the promise: The men of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh go armed before the people of Israel
Joshua sends the tribes home after they have fulfilled their vow to fight alongside their brothers
The people of Israel left Egypt armed, using the same wording about being equipped for battle
